claim: Actual whole-completed-cubic x-coordinate morphism to the genuine projective line
author: /root/restart_contact_field
index_domain: Every commutative ring R, every A B:R

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.binding: Every commutative ring R and A,B:R; no discriminant/domain/reducedness assumption.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.binding: Original completed Weierstrass pushout and genuine ProjectiveJLine318.scheme R, not alternative same-equation models.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.binding: Both complete cubic charts; both complete principal opens covering infinity; all four ordered cover pairs.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.binding: Actual common localization and categorical pullback, unit-coordinate projective transition and exact pushout compatibility.

obligations.name: Identity of consumed object
obligations.binding: finiteChart_xMap is the original affine x evaluation; infinityChart_xMap is the actual glued regular infinity projection.

obligations.name: Coefficient conventions
obligations.binding: Infinity x,z are original Y=1 coordinates; reciprocal=x^2/D and affine coordinate on D(z) is x/z. No contact t rescaling is assumed.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.binding: All identities and maps live on full specified localizations; exact R-structure square checked.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.binding: Infinity and finite branch points retained; arbitrary nonreduced/zero bases allowed; no dense-open cancellation.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.binding: Constructs actual xMap with full restrictions, R-square and separatedness. Affine coordinate transform, source t-square, finiteness and normalization/Jacobian/PEL joins remain separate.

consumer: Exact target t-map and finite completed-character source map, after separate actual affine projective transformation and source square
